mapper.select: SELECT *, lon AS longitude, lat AS latitude, ST_AsText(point) AS geomText, -- 计算到震中距离（米） ST_Distance( ST_Transform(point, 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857) ) AS distance_meters FROM xian_store_points WHERE -- 筛选距离≤100公里（100000米）的记录 ST_Distance( ST_Transform(point, 3857), ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4490), 3857) ) <= 50000 ORDER BY distance_meters ASC
